starterDescription: Small, useful datasets that can be published automatically into a new Chartize catalog.

datasets.title: Donald Trump approval — daily average
datasets.description: Daily modeled approval, disapproval, and net approval for Donald Trump’s second presidential term.
datasets.attribution: SnoutCounter; underlying polls credited by pollster in the source data
datasets.notes: Use this for the headline trend chart. Show methodology and uncertainty; do not present an average as a direct survey result.

datasets.title: Presidential approval — individual polls
datasets.description: Poll-level presidential job approval observations used by the SnoutCounter model.
datasets.attribution: SnoutCounter and the named original pollsters
datasets.notes: Retain pollster, field dates, population, sample size, sponsor, and source URL. Poll copyrights and reuse terms may differ.

datasets.title: 2026 generic congressional ballot — daily average
datasets.description: Daily Democratic and Republican generic-ballot estimates for the 2026 midterm cycle.
datasets.attribution: SnoutCounter; underlying polls credited by pollster in the source data
datasets.notes: Useful as the second political trend dataset and for comparing model movement with presidential approval.

datasets.title: County population estimates, 2020–2025
datasets.description: Resident population totals and components of change for U.S. states and counties, Vintage 2025.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
datasets.notes: Join to county boundaries with zero-padded STATE || COUNTY FIPS. Do not mix vintages in one time series.

datasets.title: U.S. state boundaries, 1:5m
datasets.description: Generalized 2025 Census cartographic state boundaries suitable for national web maps.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files
datasets.notes: Use generalized boundaries for display, not surveying, routing, or precise area calculations.

datasets.title: U.S. county boundaries, 1:5m
datasets.description: Generalized 2025 Census county and county-equivalent boundaries for choropleth maps.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files
datasets.notes: GEOID is the five-character county join key. Connecticut uses planning-region county equivalents.

datasets.title: MTA subway service lines
datasets.description: Official MultiLineString geometries for New York City Subway and Staten Island Railway services.
datasets.license: New York State Open Data Terms of Use
datasets.notes: A service may have more than one geometry row. Join the service field to line-level performance metrics and retain every segment.

datasets.title: MTA subway stations
datasets.description: Official subway and Staten Island Railway station locations, services, structures, and ADA status.
datasets.license: New York State Open Data Terms of Use
datasets.notes: Station rows include GTFS stop and complex identifiers. Use complex_id when analysis should treat connected stations as one place.

datasets.title: NYC borough boundaries
datasets.description: Shoreline-clipped boundaries for New York City's five boroughs.
datasets.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
datasets.notes: The geometry is modified to fit the NYC base map and excludes water areas; do not use it for surveying or legal boundaries.

datasets.title: MTA subway customer journey metrics, 2024–2025
datasets.description: Monthly peak and off-peak route estimates for passengers, extra platform time, extra train time, and journey-time performance.
datasets.license: New York State Open Data Terms of Use
datasets.notes: Additional platform and train time are modeled customer-delay estimates. Weight route summaries by num_passengers instead of averaging months indiscriminately.

datasets.title: Central Park daily weather, 2024–2025
datasets.description: Two full years of daily maximum and minimum temperature and precipitation at NOAA station USW00094728.
datasets.attribution: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, Daily Summaries
datasets.notes: Values use metric units. TAVG is not present on every day; examples derive a daily midpoint from TMAX and TMIN when needed.

datasets.title: USDA major land uses, 1945–2017
datasets.description: National, regional, and state acreage estimates for cropland, grassland, forests, special uses, urban land, and other land.
datasets.attribution: USDA Economic Research Service, Major Land Uses
datasets.notes: Values are thousands of acres. The latest complete national inventory is 2017; do not imply that the categorical inventory is annual or current-year land cover.

datasets.title: ACS county profile, 2020–2024
datasets.description: County population, median household income, poverty, home value, age, education, race, housing, and internet-access indicators.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020–2024 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
datasets.notes: Requires a Census API key in 2026. Store estimates and margins of error together; join on state + county FIPS.

datasets.title: CDC PLACES county health estimates, 2025
datasets.description: Forty modeled measures covering health outcomes, prevention, risk behavior, disability, status, and social needs.
datasets.attribution: CDC PLACES, Division of Population Health
datasets.notes: Model-based estimates are not suitable for evaluating a local intervention. Keep confidence limits and measure identifiers.

datasets.title: County presidential returns, 2000–2024
datasets.description: Candidate- and voting-mode-level presidential returns for U.S. counties across seven elections.
datasets.attribution: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Harvard Dataverse V20.0
datasets.notes: Harvard Dataverse V20.0 file 13573089 requires a download-guestbook response. Download it through the DOI, then upload the TSV in Admin; preserve the DOI/version and join county_fips only where present.

datasets.title: 2024 Election Administration and Voting Survey
datasets.description: Jurisdiction-level election administration, registration, turnout, mail voting, provisional voting, and polling-place data.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Election Assistance Commission, EAVS 2024 Version 2.0
datasets.notes: Download the CSV and codebook together. Several fields require codebook-derived labels.

datasets.title: County personal income, 1969–2024
datasets.description: BEA CAINC1 personal income, population, and per-capita personal income time series for counties and higher-level areas.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Economic Accounts
datasets.notes: The importer selects CAINC1__ALL_AREAS from the official archive. Preserve LineCode, unit, GeoFIPS, and footnote flags.

datasets.title: County GDP, 2001–2024
datasets.description: BEA CAGDP1 real GDP, quantity index, current-dollar GDP, and implicit price deflator time series for counties and higher-level areas.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Economic Accounts
datasets.notes: The importer selects CAGDP1__ALL_AREAS from the official archive. Preserve LineCode, unit, GeoFIPS, and footnote flags.

datasets.title: County labor force and unemployment
datasets.description: Monthly and annual county labor force, employment, unemployment, and unemployment-rate series.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Local Area Unemployment Statistics
datasets.notes: BLS blocks generic automated downloads from some networks. Use its API or download archive and retain series metadata.
